notes: PCA congregation in the Catalina Foothills; it also runs Pusch Ridge Christian Academy. Address 2150 E Orange Grove Rd, Tucson AZ 85718 confirmed on the church's own site on 2026-09-10; coordinates still not set - run tools/geocode.py. LEADERSHIP TRANSITION IS NOW RESOLVED: lead pastor John Stone resigned in April 2024, the PCA posted a lead-pastor search profile in June 2025, and the current staff page lists ROB PENDLEY as 'Lead Pastor and Teaching Elder'. A web search indicates the congregation voted him in on 2025-09-07 with a transition date of 2025-10-06, but that detail comes from a search snippet, not a page I opened, so treat the exact dates as unverified. Paul Utnage and Chad Turner no longer appear anywhere on the staff page and are now marked inactive; I could not establish when or why they left, so do not state a reason publicly. That still means sermons from roughly 2024 through mid-2025 are split across several preachers - per-sermon attribution is essential; do not attribute the whole archive to Pendley. Other current staff: Byron Johns (Executive Director) and John Miller (Director of Shepherding), neither carrying a pastor title. YOUTUBE FOUND: @catalinafoothillschurch2941 (channel id UCWQTcdozsPo8VB9v885tWSQ). Sermon playlists recorded are 'Worship Services' and 'Traditional Worship Service'; the channel also has series playlists ('Gospel Hope for Depression and Anxiety', 'Made in the Image of God') and non-sermon playlists (Tuesday Morning Devotional, The Bereans Class, Devotions, Special Events) that should be excluded from a sermon corpus.
